tables.name: sr_local_id_allocator
columns: next_value INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(next_value BETWEEN 1 AND 100000000)
rules: allocation occurs inside the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE UnitOfWork that inserts the Service Request
values 1 through 99999999 are allocatable and format as LSR- followed by exactly eight zero-padded decimal digits
next_value=100000000 is an exhausted sentinel and is never formatted or assigned as a Service Request identifier
when next_value is the exhausted sentinel creation fails with SR_LOCAL_ID_EXHAUSTED before any allocator or Service Request mutation
after successful allocation next_value increments exactly once, so allocating LSR-99999999 transitions the allocator atomically to the exhausted sentinel
rolled-back creation rolls allocator increment back with it
an allocated identifier committed to any SR is never reassigned even if future separately authorized deletion existed
